summary: Transcript data model (frozen+slotted Word/Segment/Transcript with validation, text/is_empty/word_count, iteration, schema_version-1 to_dict/from_dict exact round-trip) and deterministic timestamp utilities (format_timestamp srt/vtt/clock with half-up ms rounding, carry, negative clamp, >=100h growth; humanised format_duration). 223 tests cover construction, validation errors, round-trips incl.
